about: architecture A for enhanced_res: quality gate and OOD gate (in parallel; re-aim wins if both fire) -> temperature -> LAC CP set. Written by enhanced_res/arch_a/calibrate.py; read by enhanced_res/arch_a/runtime.py.

temperature.kind: probability temperature: p ** (1/T), renormalised; fitted on val by NLL

cp.score: LAC: 1 - tempered probability of the true class
cp.rule: set = every class with tempered probability >= 1 - q[alpha]

quality_gate.score: -log(min over stats of the tail probability vs the val reference)

ood_gate.score: 1 - mean cosine similarity to the k nearest train features

aon.about: P(not aircraft skin) = sigmoid(((f - mu) / sd) @ coef + intercept); f = EnhancedRes.features
